tagline: Making life better and brighter through Jesus

mission.en: At Awakening Generations Church, we are dedicated to evangelizing God’s Word in Nepali, exalting His glory, edifying our community for spiritual growth, and equipping believers for a purposeful, godly life. We strive to be a spiritually rich and supportive faith community, embracing our unique cultural heritage while advancing the teachings of Christ.

vision.en: Our vision at Awakening Generations Church is to be a beacon of hope and faith for the Nepali-speaking community. We envisage inspiring and empowering believers to lead fulfilling lives rooted deeply in the teachings of Scripture, fostering a vibrant and enduring legacy of faith, hope, and love across generations.

fourE.name: Equipping
fourE.en: Preparing believers for a purposeful, godly life.

fourE.name: Evangelism
fourE.en: Our mandate is to spread the Good News.

fourE.name: Exaltation
fourE.en: We aim to honor and glorify God above all.

fourE.name: Edification
fourE.en: We seek to strengthen our community's spiritual growth.
